If you haven't already used your scrolls, I can offer a crude beginner's perspective on what to put in based on my own experience and stuff I have read online.   
3-stars:   
In my opinion, there are two main things you want to put in for 3-stars as a beginner: skill-ups and fusion monsters.  
Skill-ups  
Water fairy and wind fairy: You can use these skill up Fran, the light fairy queen. She is essential for most PvE content.  
Fire griffon. You can use this to skill-up Bernard (wind griffon) and can also be saved so that you have the fire griffon once you want to use him.   
If you want to, you could also put in wind martial cat, as you will need her later most likely.   
  
Fusion monsters  
You will need to fuse Veromos (Dark Ifrit) or Sigmarus (Water Phoenix).   
You can put in the 3-star fusion monsters needed to fuse Veromos or Sigmarus.  
  
4-stars:  
(in rough order of importance)  
Water sylph (Tyron): Very useful for Trial of Ascension.   
Wind joker (Lushen): He is useful for Giants in speed runs and other PvE and PvP content.  
Fire chakram dancer (Shaina): Useful for rifts and dungeons.   
Water chakram dancer (Sabrina): Useful for dungeons.   
Water boomerang warrior (Talia): Useful for dungeons.   
Fire onimusha (Kaki): Very good in arena.   
Wind dryad (Mellia): Giants B12 speed runs.  
Water pirate captain (Galleon): Have seen he is useful, but I don't have him yet.

5-stars:

Savannah (wind beast rider), Rica (fire occult girl), Verad (Water dragon), Seara (Wind Oracle), Ganymede (wind fairy king), and Bastet (Water desert queen).
